title: Matriarch Shyra
summary: Fight Matriarch Shyra with her linked protectors and enforcers inside the shadow's tether.
overview: Fight Matriarch Shyra with her linked protectors and enforcers inside the shadow's tether.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign the full linked pack and keep every target within the shadow's tether.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Shyra, protectors and enforcers repeatedly share aggression while any is engaged.
Every six seconds, each checks its distance from Shyra's Shadow.
Moving farther than 210 units from that anchor heals the enemy fully, clears hate and returns it to its bind point.

notes: Approval E404. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
